description: This file defines the class PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector, which implements the IPlacementFilterDirector interface. It contains logic to filter a list of silos based on matching metadata keys and values, prioritizing silos that match the most important metadata keys according to a specified strategy.

classes.name: PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector
classes.description: A class that filters silos based on preferred matching metadata keys and values, used in placement strategies within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters a list of silos based on matching metadata keys and values, prioritizing silos with the highest score based on the specified strategy.
